# EHS PRO SERVICES
## Protecting Environment. Ensuring Health & Safety.

EHS PRO SERVICES is a turnkey industrial EHS (Environment, Health & Safety) compliance engineering firm based in Amaravathi, Andhra Pradesh, India. We serve factories, chemical plants, pharmaceutical units, food processing industries, and large commercial complexes across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.

## Services

### 1. Environmental Laboratory & Testing Services
NABL and CPCB approved analytical testing protocols covering:
- Drinking Water Quality Analysis (IS 10500 standards - TDS, pH, hardness, E. Coli, heavy metals)
- Effluent & Wastewater Testing (BOD, COD, TSS, hexavalent chromium, lead)
- Ambient & Stack Air Quality Monitoring (PM2.5, PM10, SO2, NOx, isokinetic stack sampling)
- Industrial Noise Level Surveys (Leq mapping, Factory Act compliance, audiometric zoning)
- Soil & Sludge Evaluation (TCLP leachate testing, hazardous waste classification)

URL: https://www.ehsproservices.in/lab-testing

### 2. Pollution Control Board (PCB) Liaison & Compliance
State and Central PCB representation services:
- Consent for Establishment (CFE): Pre-construction industrial categorization (Red/Orange/Green), EMP submission, zoning clearances
- Consent for Operation (CFO): Post-commissioning pollution control proofs, hazardous waste authorization under Rule 6, PCB member secretary representation
- Annual Compliance (ACC): Form-V environmental statement, Form-4 hazardous waste returns, EPR documentation, surprise inspection defense

URL: https://www.ehsproservices.in/pcb-compliance

### 3. Turnkey Fire Protection Infrastructure & PESO NOC
NBC Part IV and PESO certified services:
- Municipal Fire NOC new issuances, expansions, and renewals
- PESO approvals for chemical warehouses, Class A/B/C petroleum bulk storage, explosive magazine clearances
- Fire Hydrant Networks & Ring Mains (Class C heavy seamless carbon steel, multi-stage pump automation, hydrostatic testing)
- Addressable Fire Alarm Systems, smoke detection, and PA/public address emergency systems

Design codes: NBC 2016 Part IV, NFPA 13/20/72, TAC
URL: https://www.ehsproservices.in/fire-protection

### 4. ETP & STP Water Engineering (Zero Liquid Discharge)
Custom-engineered water treatment solutions:
- Effluent Treatment Plants (ETP): Chemical flash mixers, lamella clarifiers, DAF units, MBBR/SBR aerobic reactors, dual media and activated carbon tertiary filtration
- Sewage Treatment Plants (STP): MBR, MBBR, SBR with PLC/SCADA automation, UV sterilizers, chlorine/ozone dosing
- Comprehensive Project Lifecycle: Site assessment, P&ID blueprinting, civil engineering, fabrication, installation, annual O&M contracts

URL: https://www.ehsproservices.in/water-engineering
